name: cklph-diagram
description: Accessible, brand-correct diagrams as self-contained HTML with inline SVG, in 41 types, exported to SVG, PNG, GIF and MP4. A multi-brand token registry refuses to render a client whose brand is not onboarded, and WCAG AA is checked by script. Client brands live in ~/.config/cklph-diagram/brands, so updates never touch them. Imports draw.io, Mermaid and Excalidraw.
